title: WorkPulse employee.created v1
description: An employee record was created. Identifiers and contract type only — no names, emails or phones (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the event refers to (UUIDv7 string).

department_id.description: Initial department of the employee (UUIDv7 string).

position_id.description: Initial position of the employee (UUIDv7 string).

location_id.description: Initial location of the employee (UUIDv7 string).

employment_type.description: Contract type of the initial employment period.

hired_at.description: First day of the initial employment period (YYYY-MM-DD) — the tenure anchor for seniority bands. Optional (ADR 0019): pre-extension stored envelopes lack it; null/absent means unknown tenure.
